name: Popover
one_line: Gooey popover whose panel oozes out of the trigger through an SVG goo filter with a liquid neck that stretches and pinches, then crisp content fades in on top. The Morph variant reveals its full-size panel from the corner nearest the trigger on one synchronized spring clip. Click or hover trigger, controlled or uncontrolled.
